C — TEENSY ↔ AUDIO SHIELD INTERFACE (FROZEN GEOMETRY — DO NOT DISTURB)
red jumper: breadboard 48e → U3 LINE-IN-L pad
fed from RELAY_RETURN COM (16a), block F — TS or XLR return
⚠ supersedes the 2026-09-07 capture, when this input had no conductor
Net names are CODEC-REFERENCED: I2S_DIN = codec data IN (Teensy 7, SAI1_TX_DATA0);
I2S_DOUT = codec data OUT (Teensy 8, SAI1_RX_DATA0). Ref: config.h:81-85
Clocks derived from SAMPLE_RATE 44100 (config.h:208); all three scope-confirmed:
LRCLK 44.108 kHz · BCLK ~2.82 MHz · MCLK ~11.29 MHz (journal 2026-09-06 (1))
U3 "Rev D" read from silkscreen. SGTL5000 identified functionally over I²C, not
from its package marking. The shield's use of the 5V pad is UNVERIFIED.
GEOMETRY IS LOAD-BEARING — this is the fix, not a detail:
• Jumper length ≈ 25–30 mm (was 100–200 mm flying leads)
• U3 sits ≈ 25 mm above U2, bundle held tight, 1:1 screw → pad
• Result: 360/360 clean windows, 0 corrupted of 11,520 samples/node
• U2 is I²S MASTER — it generates MCLK / BCLK / LRCLK
⚠ TWO ORANGE WIRES: pin 8 (I2S_DOUT) and pin 19 (I2C_SCL).
DOUT is the conductor that caused the corruption fault.
Do not re-seat this bundle from memory. Risk R3.
D — RESERVED, AND HARDWARE DELIBERATELY NOT BUILT
Phases 6, 7 and 8 have been BUILT — see blocks E and F. What is left here is not "pending": the four jack-detect
inputs are decided against (ADR-003, ADR-004) and nothing lands on those pins. Firmware defines them at config.h:77-101.
E — RELAY_SEND · K1 · PHASE 6 · breadboard cols 49–59
pin 14 → col 53; R6 col 53 → 51, 0.993 kΩ meas
pin 14 LOW = buffer output → Rig Send (default, and the boot state)
pin 14 HIGH = codec LINE OUT L → Rig Send (monitor / injection path)
Contact map is proven BY STATE, not from the datasheet. 56a↔58a read OPEN in BOTH states,
which is what rules out a welded or make-before-break contact.
Pole 2 (56f / 57f / 58f) is NOT wired and has never been tested — NYV.
⚠ The coil is POLARIZED and was built backwards first: runbook step 7 inverts pins 1 and 10.
Built that way the coil energises normally and the contacts never transfer.
F — RELAY_RETURN · K2 · PHASE 7 · breadboard cols 8–18
14f: 4.98 V at rest · coil 4.78 V energised
→ U3 LINE IN R · I²S ch 1
pin 15 LOW = TS return → LINE IN R (default, and the boot state)
pin 15 HIGH = XLR return → LINE IN R
J6 sleeve → GND, 0.9 Ω. ⚠ J7 pins 1 AND 3 land on the BREADBOARD TOP_GND rail,
not Audio Shield ground — and 33.1 dB was measured between those two reference
points on the SOURCE path (risk R5). Signal quality only: do NOT rewire on it.
J7's detect microswitch (D2F-01L) is NOT BUILT — ADR-004. Pole 2 (15f / 16f / 17f)
not wired, and K2's own package marking has never been read back — both NYV.
⚠ This driver once stalled in the active region
during reseating. The bad connection was NEVER
identified. If it returns, measure the R8 drop
TIERS ARE NOT INTERCHANGEABLE. A part's POSITION and its VALUE are separate claims and are tagged separately.
Strip/column assignments are PHYS. Hole-level row letters are RPT (builder-reported), including every coordinate in blocks E and F.
NYV BY DECISION — open on purpose, not by oversight:
• TOP_RED continuity col 5 ↔ col 55 (GAP-5). A Phase 7 rail check would close it, but top-vs-bottom was never confirmed.
• Carrier 5V terminal provenance (X-5) · C3/C4/C5/C7 values (A1) · whether Rev D uses the 5V pad (D2).
• K2's and J7's package markings — never read back. Pole 2 of both relays — wired to nothing, never tested.
BLOCKS E AND F ARE TRANSCRIBED FROM THE BENCH RECORD, NOT FROM A FRESH INSPECTION.
Blocks A–C were captured against the board and photographs on 2026-09-07. E and F were assembled on 2026-09-22 from
ai/journal.md and ai/todo.md. Nothing was promoted in transcription; see netlist.md §14 for what is NOT evidence.
THIS DRAWING REFLECTS THE PHYSICAL BOARD, NOT docs/breadboard_bringup_v3.md.
The runbook carries documented defects in Phase 6 coil polarity, the transistor pin order and the Phase 7 column siting.
Where they conflict, the board governs. Construction complete ≠ signed off ≠ validated — Phase 9 has not been run.
